connector.name: TAR Engine
connector.registryDescription: Audit AI skill safety before you ship. Static, semantic, adversarial, supply chain scans.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tar-engine. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the qingxuantang account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TAR_ENGINE_URL
env.description: Override the audit backend. Default is the hosted playground at https://tarai.dev. Set to http://localhost:8765 (or your own tar-engine deployment) to self-host and keep SKILL.md content on your machine.

env.name: TAR_ENGINE_BYOK_OPENAI_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key that unlocks the semantic LLM and adversarial prompt-fuzz layers. Static and supply-chain layers run without it.

env.name: TAR_ENGINE_BYOK_ANTHROPIC_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key alternative to the OpenAI key for the semantic and adversarial layers.
